title: Khasi (1991) Genesis Scripture Portion
author: Bible Society of India
genre: Scriptural Prose, Linguistic Standardization & Devotional Exegesis

pages.text: --- Page 1 --- KA KITAB BANYNGKONG KA JONG U MOSES lA KABA LA KHOT JENESIS Ka jingpynlong ia ka pyrthei bad ia u briew IHa kaba mynnyngkong U Blei u la thaw ia ka bneng bad ia ka khyndew. ^Bad ka pyrthei ka la long bakhlem dur bad kaba suda, bad ka jingdum ka la long halor ka khmat ka jingjylliew, bad U Mynsiem U Blei u da khih halor ki urn. 3 Bad U

Blei u la ong, To long ka jingshai, bad ka jingshai ka la long. "^Bad U Blei u la iohi ia kata ka jingshai, ba ka la long kaba bha; bad U Blei u la pyniakhlad ia kata ka jingshai na kata ka jingdum. ^Te U Blei u

la khot Ka Sngi ia kata ka jingshai, bad ia kata ka jingdum u la khot Ka Miet. Bad kaba lajan miet ka la long bad ka step ruh ka la long, kawei ka sngi. 6 Te U Blei u la ong. To long ka suiii bneng hapdeng kita ki um, bad to ai ba kan pynkhlad ia ki um na ki um. ^Bad U Blei u la pynlong ia ka suiii bneng, bad u la pynkhlad ia kita ki um kiba hapoh kata ka suin bneng na kita ki um kiba

halor kata ka suiii bneng; te ka long kumta keiii. ^Bad ia kata ka suiii bneng, U Blei u la khot Ka Bneng. Bad kaba lajan miet ka la long, bad ka step ka la long, ka sngi kaba ar. 9 U Blei u la ong ruh, To long ba kin ialang sha kawei ka jaka kita ki um
kiba hapoh ka bneng, bad to ai kan paw ka ryngkew: te ka la long kumta keifi. ^•^Te ia kata ka ryngkew, U Blei u la khot Ka Khyndew, bad ia kata ka jingialang ki um u la khot Ki Duriaw; bad U
Blei u la iohi ba ka la long kaba bha. ''U Blei u la ong ruh, To long ba ka khyndew kan pynmih speh, ba ki jhur kin pynsei symbai, bad ba ki dieng- sch kin seisoh ha la ka jaid ka jaid, 1 :
1 lo. 1 : 1 . 1:32 Kor. 4:6. 1 : 6-« 2 Pet. 3 kiba don la u symbai hapoh jong ki, halor ka khyndew. Te ka la long kumta keiii. ^^Kumta te ka khyndew ka
la pynmih speh, bad ki jhur ruh ki la pynmih symbai ha la ka jaid ka jaid, bad ki dieng soh kiba pynseisoh ha la ka jaid ka

jaid, kiba don la u symbai hapoh jong ki; te U Blei u la iohi ba ka la long kaba bha. ^^Te kaba lajan miet ka la long, bad ka step ka la long, kaba lai ka sngi. 14 U Blei u la ong ruh. To long ki jingshai ha ka sahit bneng ban pyniakhlad hapdeng ka sngi bad ka miet; bad to ai ba

kin long ia ki dak, bad ia ki aiom, bad ia ki sngi, bad ia ki snem de:^^bad to ai ba kin long ki jingshai ha kata ka sahit ki bneng ia kaban pynshai ha ka pyrthei: te ka la long kumta ruh. *^Bad U Blei u la pynlong ia ki artylli ki jing-

shai kiba khraw; ia kata kaba kham khraw ia kaban synshar ia kaba mynsngi, bad ia kata kaba kham rit ia kaban ^iynshar ia kaba mynmiet: bad u la thaw ia ki khlur ruh. ^^Bad U Blei u la buh ia ki ha kata

ka sahit bneng ia kaban pynshai ha ka pyrthei, ^^bad ia kaban synshar ia kaba mynsngi bad ia kaba mynmiet, bad ia kaban pynkhlad ia ka jingshai na ka jingdum: te U Blei u la iohi ba ka long kaba bha. ^^Bad kaba la janmiet ka

la long, bad ka step ruh ka la long, ha ka sngi kaba saw. 20 Bad U Blei u la ong ruh, To ai ba ki um kin iaboi da kiei kiei ki kynja baim bapar, bad to ai ba kiei kiei ki kynja baher kin iaher ha khmat ka sahit bneng. ^^Te U

Blei u la thaw ia kita ki dohkha khraw kiba heh, bad ia ki kynja baim bapar baroh, da kiba kita ki um :5. 1 --- Page 2 --- JENESIS 1 ki la iaboi, ha la ka jaid ka jaid, bad ia kiei kiei ki kynja baher ruh de ha la ka jaid ka jaid: te U Blei u la iohi ba ka la long kaba bha. ^^Bad U Blei u la kyrkhu ia

ki, u da ong, To da nangkha, bad to da nangroi, bad to da pyndap ruh ia kita ki um ha ki duriaw, bad to ai ba kiei kiei ruh ki kynja baher kin ianangroi ha ka khyndew. ^^Te kaba lajan miet ka la long, bad ka step ruh ka la long, ha ka sngi kaba san. 24 U Blei u la ong ruh. To ai ba ka khyndew kan pynmih noh ia

kiei kiei ruh ki kynja bairn baroh ha la ka jaid ka jaid, ia ki jingri, bad ia kiei kiei ruh ki kynja bapar, bad ia u mrad khlaw jong ka ryngkew ha la ka jaid ka jaid: te ka la long kumta kein. ^^Kumta U Blei u

la thaw ia u mrad ka ryngkew ha la ka jaid ka jaid, bad ia ki jingri ha la ka jaid ka jaid, bad ia kiei kiei ruh ki kynja bapar baroh ha ka khyndew ha la ka jaid ka jaid: te U Blei u la iohi ba ka la long kaba bha. 26 U Blei u la ong ruh. To pgin iathaw ia u briew ha ka dur jong ngi, katba kum ka jingsyriem jong ngi hi ; bad kin synshar halor ki dohkha ka duriaw, bad halor ki sim bneng, bad halor ki kynja mrad, bad halor ka

pyrthei baroh, bad halor kiei kiei ki kynja bapar baroh kiba par halor ka khyndew. ^"^ Kumta U Blei u la thaw ia u briew ha ka dur jong u hi, ha ka dur U Blei kein u la thaw ia u; shynrang bad kynthei u la thaw ia ki. ^'^U Blei u la kyrkhu ruh ia ki, bad U Blei u la ong ha ki. To da nangkha, bad to da nangroi, bad to da pyndap ia ka khyndew, bad to da pyndem ngon ia ka: bad to synshar halor ki dohkha ka duriaw, bad halor ki
sim bneng, bad halor kiei kiei ki kynja baim baroh ba par halor ka khyndew. ^^U Blei u la ong ruh. Ha khmih, nga la ai ha phi, ban
long ka jingbam, ia u jhur baroh uba pynmih I'.U \ Kor. 11:7. 1 : 27 Mt 19 : 4; Mk. 10 : 6. 2:2-3 Ek. 20 : 11. 2 :7 1 Kor. 15 : 45. symbai, uba don halor ka khmat ka khyndew baroh, bad

ia u dieng baroh, uba don ha lade u soh jong u dieng uba pynmih symbai. ^°Bad ha u kynja mrad baroh jong ka khyndew, bad ha ki kynja baher baroh jong ka suin bneng, bad ha ki kynja bapar baroh halor ka khyndew, ba don ka jingim ha ki, nga la ai ia u jhur bajyrngam baroh ban long jingbam: bad ka la long kumta ruh.

' ^ Hadien kata U Blei u la iohi ia kiei kiei baroh ba u la lah thaw, ha khmih ruh, ka la bha eh. Te kaba lajan miet ka la long, bad kaba mynstep ruh ka la long, ha ka sngi kaba hynriew. 2 Kumta la pyndep noh ia ki bneng bad ia ka pyrthei, bad ia ki kynhun bah baroh jong ki. ^Te ha kaba hynriiew

ka sngi, U Blei u la pyndep noh ia la ka kam ia kaba u la lah pynlong; bad ha kaba hynniew ka sngi u la shong sngi na ka kam jong u baroh ia kaba u la lah pynlong. ^Bad U Blei u la kyrkhu ia kata kaba hynniew ka sngi, bad u la kyntang khuid ia ka: naba ha kane ka sngi u la shong sngi na ka kam jong u baroh ia kaba U Blei u la lah pynlong bad thaw. 4 Kane ka long

ka jingiathuhkhana shaphang ki bneng bad ka pyrthei, mynba la pynlong ia ki ha kata ka sngi ba U Trai uba U Blei u la thaw ia ka pyrthei bad ia ki bneng, ^bad ia ki jingthung baroh jong ka lyngkha mynba kim pat la long ha ka khyndew, bad ia u jhur baroh jong ka lyngkha mynba um pat la mih

speh: naba U Trai uba U Blei um pat shym la pynhiar ia u slap halor ka khyndew, bad haba u briew ruh um pat la don ia kaban rep ia ka khyndew. ^Te u lyoh u la mih na ka khyndew, bad u la ai um halor ka khmat ka khyndew baroh. ^Bad U Trai uba U Blei u la thaw ia u briew na ka dewmet ka khyndew, bad u la pyrsad ha ki thliew khmut jong 1

: 27-28 Jen. 5 : 1-2. 2 : 2 Heb. 4 : 4, 10. --- Page 3 --- u ia ka jingpyrsad ka jingim; bad uta u briew u la long ka mynsiem bairn. Ka kper Eden 8 U Trai uba U Blei ruh u la thung ia ka kper ha Ka Eden shaphang mihngi; bad u la buh hangta ia uta u briew ia uba u la lah thaw. ^Bad U Trai uba U Blei u la pynlong ba kin mih na kata ka khyndew ki dieng baroh kiba itynnad

ban khmih, bad kiba bit eh ia kaban bam; bad hapdeng kata ka kper ia u dieng ka jingim, bad ia u dieng ka jingtip ia kaba bha bad ia kaba sniew. 10 Ka wah ruh ka la mih noh na Eden ia kaban ai um ia kata ka kper; bad nangta ka la khlad, bad ka la long saw tnat. ^*Ka kyrteng jong kaba nyng- kong ka long Ka Pison: kata kaba tuid sawdong ia ka ri Habilah baroh kawei, ha kaba don ka ksiar; ^^bad

ka ksiar jong kata ka ri ka long kaba bha: hangta ruh don u bdellium bad u mawlynnai onyks. ^ ^Bad ka kyrteng ka wah kaba ar ka long Ka Gihon: kata kaba tuid sawdong ia ka ri Kush baroh kawei. ^*Bad ka kyrteng ka wah kaba lai ka long Ka Hidekel: kata kaba

tuid sha- phang mihngi ia ka ri Assyria. Bad ka wah kaba saw ka long Ka luphratis. 15 Bad U Trai uba U Blei u la shim ia uta u briew, bad u la buh ia u ha ka kper Eden ia kaban trei bad ban sumar ia ka. ^^Bad U Trai uba U Blei u la hukum ia uta u briew, u da ong, Na u dieng baroh ha ka kper, da kaba bam

me iah ban bam ei: ^''hynrei na u dieng ka jingtip ia kaba bha bad ia kaba sniew men ym ioh bam na u: naba ha kata ka sngi ba men bam na u, da kaba iap men iap shisha. 18 Bad U Trai uba U Blei u la ong ruh, Ym bit ba uta u briew un sah marwei ; ngan thaw ia u ka nongsumar lem kaba biang. ^^Bad U Trai uba U Blei u la 2:9 Jpw. 2 :7;22 : 2, 14.

2 : 24 Mt. 19 :5;Mk. 3:1 Jdw. 12 :9:20 : 2. JENESIS 3 pynlong na ka khyndew ia ki mrad ka ryngkew baroh, bad ia ki sim bneng baroh; bad u la wallam ia ki ha U Adam ban khmih kumno un buh kyrteng ia ki : bad kat kumba uta u briew u la buh kyrteng

ia kita ki kynja baim baroh, kumta hi ka la long ka kyrteng jong ki. 20Bad U Adam u la buh kyrteng ha ki kynja jingri baroh, bad ha ki sim bneng, bad ha ki mrad baroh jong ka khyndew; hynrei ia U Adam ym pat shym la shem ia ka nongsumar lem. ^iTe U Trai uba U Blei u la pynngat ha U Adam da ka jingsamthiah kaba jur, u ruh u la iohthiah : bad u la shim ia kawei na ki shyiengkrung jong u, bad u la set pat da ka doh ha ka jaka jong ka; ^He U Trai uba U Blei u la pynlong ka
briew, na kata ka shyieng krung ia kaba u la lah shim na uta u briew, bad u la wallam ia ka ha uta u briew. ^^Bad U Adam u la ong, Kane

mynta shisha ka long ka shyieng na ki shyieng jong nga, bad ka doh na ka doh jong nga: ia kane kein yn khot Ka Briew, namarba la shim ia ka na U Briew. ^'^Namarkata keiii u briew un iehnoh ia la u kjm bad ia la ka kmie, bad un iaineh bad la ka tnga: bad kin ialong ruh kawei ka doh. 2 5Te ki la long kiba lyngkhuid baroh ar-

ngut, uta u briew bad ka tnga jong u, bad kim shym la sngewlehrain. Ka jinghap jong u briew 3Te uta u bsein u la long uba kham sian ia ki mrad baroh ka ryngkew ia kiba U Trai uba U Blei u la lah thaw. Bad u la ong ha kata ka briew, Shisha, ka long kumta, ba U Blei u la ong, Phin ym ioh bam na u dieng baroh ha ka kper? 2Bad kata ka briew ka la ong ha uta u bsein, Na u soh ki dieng ha ka kper ngi ioh ban bam: ^hynrei na u soh jong uta u dieng uba hapdeng ka kper, U Blei u la ong, Phin ym

ioh bam na u, lymne 10 :7-8; 1 Kor. 6 :16;Eph. 5 :31. --- Page 4 --- JENESIS 3 ktah ia u, ba ioh phin iap noh. "^Te uta u bseiii u la ong ha kata ka briew, Phin ym iap noh shisha: ^Namar U Blei u tip ba, ha kata ka sngi ba phin

bam na u, un sa pynpeit ia ki khmat jong phi, bad ba phin long kum ki blei, kiba tip ia kaba bha bad ia kaba sniew. ^Te haba kata ka briew ka la iohi ba uta u dieng u la long uba bha ban bam, bad uba itynnad ia ki khmat, bad u dieng uba bit ia kaban pynstad, ka la shim na u soh jong u, bad ka la bam

ruh, bad ka la ai lem ruh de ha la u tnga; u ruh u la bam. "^Hadien kata la pynpeit ia ki khmat jong ki baroh arngut, bad ki la tip ba ki la long kiba lyngkhuid; bad ki la iasuh lang ia ki sla u dieng dumbur, bad ki la iathaw

ia lade ia ki jingpanpoh. 8 Te ki la iohsngew ia ka jingsawa U Trai uba U Blei ba u da wan iaid ha ka kper ha ka jingpyngngad ka sngi: te U Adam bad ka tnga jong u ki la iabuhrieh ia lade na khmat U Trai uba U Blei hapdeng ki dieng jong kata ka kper. ^Te U Trai uba U Blei u la khot

ia U Adam, bad u da ong ha u, Me don shaei? ^°U te u la ong, Nga la iohsngew ia ka jingsawa jong me ha ka kper, nga te nga la sheptieng, naba nga la lyngkhuid; bad nga la buhrieh ia lade. ^^Bad U Blei u la ong, Uei ba la iathuh ha me ba me la lyngkhuid? Shisha me la bam na uta u dieng ia uba nga la adong ia me ban ym bam na u? ^^Te U Adam u la iathuh, Kata ka briew ia kaba me la buh lok

bad nga, ka long ma ka keiii kaba la ai ha nga na uta u dieng, bad nga la kum bam. i^Te U Trai uba U Blei u la ong ha kata ka briew, Kaei kane ia kaba pha la leh? Te kata ka briew ka la iathuh, Uta u bseiii u la shukor ia nga, nga ruh nga la kum bam. ^^Hadien kata U Trai U Blei u la ong ha uta u bsein, Namarba me la leh ia kane, la tim

ia me nalor ki 3:13 2Kor. 11 : 3; 1 Tim. 2 3 : 22 Jpw. 22 : 14. kynja jingri baroh, bad nalor ki kynja mrad ka ryngkew baroh; da ka kpoh jong me men par, bad ia ka dewmet men bam baroh ki sngi ka rta jong me

. ^^Bad ia ka jingshun ruh ngan buh hapdeng jong me bad kata ka briew, bad hapdeng u symbai jong me bad u symbai jong ka; u symbai jong ka un pynlwet ia ka khlieh jong me bad me men pynlwet ia ka khongdongjat jong u. ^^Bad ha kata ka briew u la ong. Da kaba pynroi ngan pynroi ia ki jingpang jong pha,

bad ia ka jingseng khun jong pha; ha ka jingshitom phan kha ki khun; bad ka jingkwah jong pha kan long sha u tnga jong pha, bad u un synshar halor jong pha. ^"^Bad ha U Adam u la ong, Namar- ba me la shahshkor ia ka ktien ka tnga jong me, bad ba me la bam na uta u dieng, ia uba nga la adong ia me, da kaba ong, Men ym bam na u : ia ka

khyndew la tim na ka bynta jong me; da ka jingshitom men bam na ka baroh ki sngi ka rta jong me; ^^kan pynmih shylluit ruh ia ki shiah bad ia ki shiah keng ia me; bad men bam ia u jhur ka lyngkha. ^^Da ka jingsyep ka khmat jong me men bam

ia la u kpu, haduh ban da men phaidien pat sha ka khyndew ; namar na' ka la shim ia me: naba ka dewmet me long, bad sha ka dewmet men leit phai pat. 20 Te U Adam u la khot kyrteng ia la ka tnga, Ka Im; naba la long ma ka ka kmie jong kiba im baroh. ^Ua U Adam ruh bad ia ka tnga jong u U Trai uba U Blei u la thaw ia ki jingkup snieh, bad u la pynkup ruh ia ki. 22 U Trai uba U Blei u

la ong ruh. Ha khmih, uta u briew u la wan long kum uwei na ngi hi, kat ban tip ia kaba bha bad ia kaba sniew: te mynta, ba ioh un kner ia la ka kti, bad shim ruh na u dieng ka jingim, bad bam, bad im junom ruh de: ^^namarkata U Trai uba U : 14. 3 : 15 Jpw. 12 : 17. 3 : 17-18 Heb. 6 --- Page 5 --- Blei u la beh noh ia u na ka kper Eden,

ia kaban rep ia ka khyndew na kaba la shim ia u. ^'^Kumta keiii u la beh noh ia uta u briew; bad u la buh ia ki kherub shaphang mihngi ka kper Eden, bad ia kaba kum ka waitlam baphyrnai, kaba da khih talaiii baroh sawdong, ia kaban sumar ia ka lynti sha uta u dieng ka jingim. THE HOLY BIBLE Khasi - O.V. Reference.
